# FactMatch

> A beautiful, privacy-first fact discovery app. Learn something new every scroll.

FactMatch is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that presents fascinating facts from Wikipedia and free knowledge APIs in a Pinterest-style masonry feed. Users swipe right on facts they find interesting and left to skip. The feed learns preferences over time using local on-device storage — no accounts, no servers, no tracking.

## What FactMatch Does

- Fetches live facts from Wikipedia Random Articles, Wikipedia "On This Day", Open Trivia Database, Cat Facts API, Dog Facts API, and Advice Slip API
- Displays facts in a masonry grid with beautiful images from Picsum Photos
- Supports 63 topic categories: Science, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Space, Climate, Nature, Geology, Oceanography, Tech, AI, Robotics, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Inventions, History, Geography, Travel, Politics, Economics, Business, Finance, Cryptocurrency, Law, Education, Mythology, Folklore, Archaeology, Military, Crime, Art, Literature, Design, Movies, Entertainment, Music, Architecture, Fashion, Comics, Gaming, Photography, Theatre, Anime, Dance, Healthcare, Psychology, Neuroscience, Mental Health, Fitness, Nutrition, Cooking, Meditation, Sustainability, Sociology, Linguistics, Relationships, Animals, Food, Philosophy, Sports, General
- Personalized feed via on-device preference learning — no server-side profiling
- Users can export a shareable profile card as an image
- Periodic recall quiz to reinforce learning

## Technical Stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router) with React 19
- TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
- GSAP 3.15 for animations
- Framer Motion for card interactions
- Lenis for smooth scrolling
- PWA with service worker — works offline with cached content

## Privacy

FactMatch stores all data (swipe history, preferences, profile) exclusively in the user's browser localStorage. No data is sent to any server. No analytics. No cookies. No accounts required.

## Source Data

All facts are fetched live from free public APIs:
- Wikipedia API (https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/)
- Open Trivia DB (https://opentdb.com/api.php)
- Cat Facts (https://catfact.ninja/fact)
- Dog Facts (https://dogapi.dog/api/v2/facts)
- Advice Slip (https://api.adviceslip.com/advice)

## Intended Audience

People who want to learn interesting things casually — students, curious adults, trivia enthusiasts, lifelong learners. FactMatch replaces mindless doom-scrolling with knowledge discovery.
